evidence_classes.analytical_platform_assumption: 50 GB/s per-rank PCIe, 400 GB/s shared DRAM, and 450 GB/s one-way NVLink are explicit unmeasured inputs.
evidence_classes.exact_model_geometry: Revision-pinned Qwen config/checkpoint metadata and exact TP4 KV-head geometry.
evidence_classes.exact_trace_observation: Request geometry and inter-turn timing from the hashed input workload. Token counts remain source-tokenizer surrogates.
evidence_classes.kernel_calibrated_analytical_compute_end: Kernel-decomposed analytical equations are fitted to legacy Llama-3.1-70B and Mixtral artifacts labeled H100. Exact H100 SKU and measurement software are unknown; Qwen geometry, 1M attention, and DCA/MInference remain extrapolations.
evidence_classes.nominal_capacity_and_manufacturer_upper_: H100 uses its marketed 80 GB SI capacity. Aggregate eight-drive CM6 55.2/33.6 GB/s is nameplate arithmetic, not an end-to-end fio measurement.
evidence_classes.official_approximate_statement: Qwen model-card 240 GB whole-engine and up-to-3x speedup statements; the speedup defines only a labeled one-third attention-work sensitivity, not a whole-prompt multiplier.

same_model_current_profile.reason: Wrong hardware, no TP4 measurement, and no 1M DCA/MInference kernel surface. It cannot support an absolute H100 1M latency claim.

experiment_contract.pd_layout: one TP4 prefill replica plus one TP4 decode replica
experiment_contract.weight_layout_semantics: Attention and dense tensors are TP4-sharded; 128 MoE experts are evenly EP4-sharded on the same four GPUs.

dgx_h100_system_guide.supports: 80 GB GPUs, 2 TB system memory, 8 x 3.84 TB SSD

h100_specification.supports: H100 roofline and 900 GB/s aggregate NVLink source; 450 GB/s one-way is an explicit directional inference

hardware_sources.hash_semantics: Observed source bytes on 2026-07-20 UTC. NVIDIA web pages are not revision pinned or vendored, so their hashes identify the consulted page representations rather than immutable artifacts. The KIOXIA PDF is a directly hashed product brief.

model_geometry.kv_storage_semantics: Retain BF16 K and V for every token at all 48 layers. DCA and MInference change the compute endpoint but are not assumed to compress or discard the reusable KV allocation.

analytical_model.bands: p10/p50/p90 fitted eta sensitivities, not confidence intervals
analytical_model.eta_fit: robust p50 of a contiguous upper-shape training tail; fast=p10 and slow=p90

cases.name: half_residual
cases.provenance: Sensitivity derived from the official model card's approximate 240 GB whole-engine statement. The target non-KV bytes/rank equal exact checkpoint bytes/rank plus 0.5 times the inferred residual. The core reserve is adjusted because the replay subtracts its architecture-derived weight estimate.

reserve_derivation.interpretation: Residual inferred from an approximate whole-engine model-card statement after exact checkpoint and KV subtraction. It is not a measured activation or runtime reserve.
reserve_derivation.pd_application: The sensitivity is applied independently to both P4 roles. P4+D4 duplicates weights and role-local runtime state; the model card's approximate 240 GB statement is not itself a P/D-topology measurement.

workload.context_eligibility_semantics: input_toks + output_toks <= max_context_tokens; the model context window includes both prompt and generated tokens
workload.fresh_prompt_token_semantics: Execution fresh tokens are always max(0, input_toks - effective_reuse_toks). raw_newly_append_toks is preferred over newly_append_toks and preserved separately as declared_newly_append_tokens.
workload.token_count_provenance: TraceLab source-provider token-count surrogates; not exact Qwen tokenizer IDs. No request is padded to 1M.

tokenizers.note: TraceLab has no sanitized prompt text. LMCache has no standalone output field, but a normal continuation carries the previous assistant message in its next cumulative prompt. Source-reported counts are retained where target retokenization is impossible.
tokenizers.source: reported per source model when available

tracelab_source.sha256_interpretation: A declared_and_verified hash is bound by both the sidecar and the currently readable source file. A computed-only hash identifies the source path at experiment time but does not prove that identical bytes were used at conversion time.
